on Monday its CEO, Ning Tang, was placed under criminal measures in an investigation involving affiliates of its controlling shareholder.
The company said it has received no official notice about the investigation and is unable to comment on its progress or possible outcome.
The company said the investigation could limit Tang’s ability to lead for an extended period and negatively affect its reputation and financial performance.
The board and management are developing contingency plans for potential leadership, operational, and governance impacts, while business operations continue as usual.
